content.query:
WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' and CustomerAccountId in (
'c186c0397aa248ebd31aa5b13be5229f',
'dd4dbe914182e2265087fff8d9db81df',
'a077664a55012b654c1eefe7d38c87c1')
)
,Balance AS (
SELECT
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SUM(PermanentCreditLimit) PermanentCreditLimit
,SUM(CurrentCreditLimit) CurrentCreditLimit
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCL.[TIMESTAMP],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Permanent Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0) ELSE NULL END AS PermanentCreditLimit
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0) ELSE NULL END AS CurrentCreditLimit
,BCL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm                                                                                          
FROM 
CustomerAccountLimit BCL
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID and DDB.CURRENTindicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID  and DDA.CURRENTindicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPaymentCard] BCP ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCP.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[PaymentCard] BPC ON BPC.PaymentCardId = BCP.PaymentCardId
) A
GROUP BY
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)


, GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode,
    MIN(BusinessDateSK) as min_date, 
    MAX(BusinessDateSK) max_date 
  FROM 
    Balance
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
     BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) --AND BusinessDateSk >= '2023-01-01'
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
     BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, PermanentCreditLimit, CurrentCreditLimit, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance b
WHERE (--BranchSK IS NOT NULL
     BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate)),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm        
,PermanentCreditLimit
,CurrentCreditLimit
--,LimitTypeId
--,LimitAmount 
--,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row1
, case when [CurrentCreditLimit] is null AND [PermanentCreditLimit] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON --a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    --AND 
	a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
 --   AND a.DemandFlowId = b.DemandFlowId

)

, rowgrp as(
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row1) RowGroup 
 from join_balance)


select distinct
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when PermanentCreditLimit is not null then PermanentCreditLimit else first_value(PermanentCreditLimit) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row1) end PermanentCreditLimit
,case when CurrentCreditLimit  is not null then CurrentCreditLimit  else first_value(CurrentCreditLimit) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row1) end CurrentCreditLimit 
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm                           
from rowgrp
